recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-12899; do not duplicate FHIR-27019, which is the separate later-change record for basedOn wording.
issue_request: FHIR-12899 was a Published Pharmacy change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked how a MedicationAdministration can link to the original prescription/order, individual MedicationRequest instance-order, and care plan context; the approved action was to rename MedicationAdministration.prescription to MedicationAdministration.request and document that request can reference a MedicationRequest order or instance-order.
initial_application: Git commit fb85e74cbc7631131c5e76eb713022eae4cd0de5 applied Tracker 12899 by renaming the MedicationAdministration spreadsheet element and search parameter from prescription to request, adding the order/instance-order comment, and updating examples from <prescription> to <request>.
additional_context: MedicationAdministration is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition has MedicationAdministration.basedOn for CarePlan and MedicationAdministration.request for the authorizing MedicationRequest. Later Published issue FHIR-27019 confirmed that request points to the authorizing request/order while basedOn points to a care plan, and FHIR-27019 is already separately represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current active source contains MedicationAdministration.request with a comment allowing MedicationRequest intent order or instance-order, the request search parameter is expressed against MedicationAdministration.request, examples use <request>, and targeted searches found no active MedicationAdministration.prescription path to fix.

related_jiras.note: Published Pharmacy issue that revisited request versus basedOn, confirmed request as the authorizing request/order and basedOn as care plan context, and is already represented on the combined branch by commit 3186dbfc7568af9b5f4420775f2e489c69310ec5.
